mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) carries risk of nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, while lacosamide is renally cleared; combined use may impair renal function and increase lacosamide accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN, eGFR) regularly during concurrent use; adjust lacosamide dosing if renal impairment develops; monitor for signs of ototoxicity.
